in_hebrew.name: Eurydice
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Wealthy in justice
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Eurydice הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek 'Eurydike', derived from 'eurus' meaning 'good, wealthy' and 'dike' meaning 'justice'. In Greek mythology, Eurydice was the wife of Orpheus and was taken by Hades after Orpheus failed to save her. Orpheus then descended into the underworld to reclaim her.

in_greek.name: Ευρύδικη
in_greek.long_meaning: wide, broad, ample, rich, fruitful, generous, just, righteous, lawful, equal; a title of the goddesses Dike and Themis

in_latin.name: Eurydice
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Wealthy in justice
in_latin.long_meaning: Eurydice est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek 'Eurydike', derived from 'eurus' meaning 'good, wealthy' and 'dike' meaning 'justice'. In Greek mythology, Eurydice was the wife of Orpheus and was taken by Hades after Orpheus failed to save her. Orpheus then descended into the underworld to reclaim her.
